content.short: OORT is a decentralized cloud for privacy and cost savings.
content.description: OORT enables people to fully own and control their data, with natural language serving as a seamless gateway for effortless interaction. As demand for affordable computing power grows in fields like AIGC, Web3, and the Metaverse, privacy becomes a central concern for data storage and processing. OORT's core technology and AI Interaction are designed to accelerate the widespread adoption of decentralized infrastructure, empowering users and developers to collaborate with confidence.
